definitions.gloss: being from the same hometown or home region
definitions.explanation: Coming from the same town, prefecture or region as someone else. It often explains a sense of closeness between people who meet far from home.

examples.english: He and I are from the same hometown.

examples.japanese: {同郷|どうきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}けられた→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: I was helped by an older person from my hometown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{同郷|どうきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うれしい。
examples.english: When I meet someone from back home in Tokyo, I enjoy being able to talk in our dialect.

notes:
⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (same) + {郷|きょう} (village, home region).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同郷|どうきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ / ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧: a person / friend from the same hometown
- {同郷|どうきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よしみ: the bond of a shared hometown
- {同郷|どうきょう}⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧: an association of people from the same region
